    b = n['boundary']
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]

    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"\nAvatar: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")
